name: claude-sessman
description: Local web dashboard showing all currently-running Claude Code CLI sessions

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.design:gate: python3 scripts/design/lint_hardcodes.py web/src && python3 scripts/design/check_no_emoji.py web/src CLAUDE.md docs/DESIGN.md
